title: Discrete fibration of ordinary categories
statement: Let $V:\mathcal D\to\mathcal B$ be a functor of ordinary categories, considered small in sufficiently large universes as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. It is a discrete fibration if for every $d\in\mathcal D$, $b\in\mathcal B$ and $\beta:b\to Vd$, there is a unique pair $(d\prime,\delta:d\prime\to d)$ with $Vd\prime=b$ and $V\delta=\beta$ (using that equality to identify the source of $V\delta$). Uniqueness includes the domain object as well as the arrow.
